The results include several papers on regional-language social media, especially for Bengali and related low-resource languages. The closest match is a study on code-mixed Tulu social media comments for hope speech detection, which uses organically adapted text models on social media data [2]. Another paper analyzes social media polarization in Bengali comments and evaluates multiple classifiers on a manually annotated Bengali dataset [7].

If you mean broader regional-language social media research, one paper studies place-based language variation on New Zealand Reddit communities [4], while another looks at Hinglish tweets for sentiment analysis [3]. The Bengali papers focus on speech or dialect resources and dialect-aware assistance rather than social media specifically [1, 5, 6].
